ntfy.PORT: HTTP listener and healthcheck target, default 8080.
ntfy.NTFY_BASE_URL: Public HTTPS base URL, matching the Railway domain; required for links and browser push.
ntfy.NTFY_BOOTSTRAP_USER: Non-admin user reconciled at startup; alphanumeric, dash and underscore only.
ntfy.NTFY_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD: Generated 32-character password; persisted bcrypt credential is rotated on each startup.
ntfy.NTFY_TOPIC_PREFIX: Topic ACL grants prefix*; ntfy also allows the user's own private sync topic.
ntfy.NTFY_CACHE_DURATION: Finite persistent message replay retention, default 24h; not indefinite delivery.
ntfy.NTFY_MANAGER_INTERVAL: Message pruning and statistics cadence, default 1m; retention is enforced on this schedule.
